facts.text: We install dependencies with pnpm rather than npm so lockfiles never mix.
The production database listens on 5432 while staging uses 6543.
Retries use exponential backoff capped at thirty seconds.
Deploys happen after ten in the evening on Wednesdays.
Session memories expire after seven days; project memories last ninety days.
The service must never write API keys into logs.
Feature flags are evaluated on the server, never in the browser.
Images are resized to 1600 pixels wide before upload.
The mobile client is built with React Native.
Nightly backups run at 2am and keep fourteen days of history.
Only the on-call engineer may approve a hotfix.
Search results are capped at two hundred rows per page.
The API rate limit is one hundred requests per minute per token.
We run Postgres 16 with the pgvector extension.
Customer emails are encrypted at rest with AES-256.
The design system ships a dark theme by default.
